name: Netflix

fastest.text: Open netflix.com/cancelplan in a browser, sign in, then select Cancel and Finish Cancellation.

steps: Go to netflix.com/cancelplan in a web browser and sign in if asked.
Look for Netflix's confirmation email so you know it went through.
note: No cancel option on the page? Then a partner bills you (for example your phone, internet or TV provider), and you cancel with them instead.

faq.q: Do I keep watching after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes. You can keep using Netflix until the end of the billing period you've already paid for, and you won't be charged again.
No. Netflix's terms say payments are non-refundable and there are no refunds or credits for partial months.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel my membership?
faq.a: No. Signing out or deleting the app doesn't cancel anything; you have to finish the cancellation on your account page.
